Company:
Quecko Web3

Website:
https://quecko.com

Description:
Quecko Web3 is a blockchain development company that builds Layer-1 and Layer-2 blockchains, decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, and Web3 infrastructure for startups, fintech companies, and enterprises.

Services:
- L1 blockchain development
- L2 and rollup development
- dApp development
- Smart contract development
- Blockchain consulting
- Web3 integration for fintech platforms
- Wallet development (web and mobile)
- NFT platforms and marketplaces
- DeFi protocol development
- Custom web development
- Mobile application development (iOS and Android)
- UI/UX design
- 360 digital marketing

Service Details:
L1 blockchain development:
Design and build custom Layer-1 blockchains including consensus mechanisms, tokenomics, validator architecture, and network setup.

L2 and rollups:
Develop Layer-2 scaling solutions and rollups to improve transaction throughput and reduce blockchain costs.

dApp development:
Build decentralized applications with smart contract backends and Web3-enabled user interfaces.

Smart contracts:
Write, test, deploy, and maintain secure smart contracts for blockchain-based applications and protocols.

Blockchain consulting:
Advise businesses on blockchain architecture, feasibility, use cases, and implementation strategy.

Web3 integration for fintech:
Integrate blockchain functionality into fintech platforms including payments, asset tokenization, custody, and on-chain settlement.

Wallet development:
Build secure crypto wallets for web and mobile including transaction signing and key management.

NFT platforms:
Develop NFT marketplaces and minting platforms with smart contracts and user dashboards.

DeFi protocols:
Design and build decentralized finance systems including staking, lending, and liquidity platforms.
